items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I told my me buddy I'm working with Charlie Creath, a new horn and working with Charlie Creath.

ctx.x: JT: I think so. No, it couldn't have been Green's place, that's before Green's place. I folded at the roadhouse. Let me get these things together so we'll know. Green's another story. But, he said, "What are you doing tomorrow night?" Tomorrow night? "You working tomorrow night?" I said, NO, I'm not working tomorrow night. "Would you like to work with Charlie Creath?" "Charlie Creath?" Are you kidding. I just got my new horn, too, Stan, you know. I had a horn that said owner Joseph L. Thomas en-there-. Dig it.
Oh, you still got the old horn?
